description: Main front-end source file for a Flutter application implementing filters and UI theming, including environment setup, theme definitions, filter controls, and results display.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget setting theme and home page with environment loading and repository setup.

classes.name: CanonicalOption
classes.description: Represents filter label and key for ethnicity, race, etc.

classes.name: FilterPreferences
classes.description: Data Transfer Object for filters, with URL query parameter generation.

classes.name: FiltersPage
classes.description: Stateful widget providing filter controls, results display, and interaction logic.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes environment variables and runs the Flutter app.

methods.name: _oceanProScheme
methods.description: Defines a custom color scheme based on Ocean Professional palette.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Creates ThemeData with custom color scheme and widget styles.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree, including filters UI and results section.

methods.name: _applyFilters
methods.description: Fetches filtered match results asynchronously and updates UI.

methods.name: _buildResultsSection
methods.description: Builds the widget displaying filter results or loading/error states.
